name: Consona Remarketing for WooCommerce
author: consonasync

sections.description:
Consona Remarketing helps WooCommerce stores recover abandoned baskets and measure recovered revenue.

The free version includes:

  • Abandoned basket tracking
  • Recovery links
  • Recovery email sending
  • Email open tracking
  • Email click tracking
  • Revenue attribution
  • Recovery performance reporting
  • WooCommerce integration

Upgrade to Consona Remarketing Pro for:

  • Multi-step recovery campaigns
  • Previous-order remarketing
  • Customer segmentation
  • Coupon automation
  • A/B testing
  • Advanced reporting
  • Audience simulation
  • Revenue funnels
  • SMS and WhatsApp campaign support

Privacy

This plugin stores the following data within your WordPress and WooCommerce database:

  • Customer email address
  • Basket/cart contents
  • Basket value
  • Recovery token
  • Recovery timestamps
  • Email send events
  • Email open events
  • Email click events
  • Unsubscribe records
  • Revenue attribution events

The free version of Consona Remarketing does not transmit customer, order, basket, or tracking data to Consona servers.

Store owners are responsible for ensuring their use of the plugin complies with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR, UK GDPR, PECR, CCPA, and similar legislation.

External Services

The free version of Consona Remarketing does not send customer, order, basket, tracking, or unsubscribe data to Consona or any third-party service.

Recovery emails are sent using the website’s configured WordPress email system. If the site owner uses a third-party email delivery provider (for example SMTP or transactional email services), email delivery is handled according to that provider’s own terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/consona-remarketing-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the plugin from WooCommerce > Consona Remarketing.
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required.

Does the plugin send customer data to Consona?

No. The free version stores data locally in your WordPress and WooCommerce database and does not send customer data to Consona servers.

Can I disable tracking?

Yes. Tracking and consent-related settings can be configured within the plugin settings.

Does the plugin send recovery emails automatically?

Yes. Recovery emails can be sent using WordPress email functionality.
